glosses: only used in te ... digna, syntactic variant of dígnate, second-person singular imperative of dignarse

examples.text: Su valentía es digna de elogio.
examples.en: His bravery is worthy of praise.

examples.text: Su nueva novela es digna de leerse.
examples.en: His new novel is worth reading.

examples.text: Quiero que Tom tenga una oportunidad de tener una vida digna.
examples.en: I want Tom to have a chance for a decent life.
